title: Verify existing Tele host/display baseline read-only
mission: Verify the existing host-side baseline for the recovered Tele requirement before any implementation: identify the actual target host/session and secondary display/HDMI endpoint from durable or read-only runtime evidence, recover exact existing display-control scripts/workflows/primitives if present, and record SOURCE_DEBT where access or bytes are absent. Do not move windows, launch media, install dependencies, alter display configuration or design a new Tele UI in this job.
definition_of_done: The actual target host/session and secondary display/HDMI endpoint are identified from durable or read-only runtime evidence, or exact access SOURCE_DEBT is recorded without guessing.

Any existing Tele/display scripts, workflow exports, executables, configs or control primitives are enumerated with exact paths plus versions/hashes where obtainable; absence is reported only within the searched scope.
Read-only detection is used exclusively; no display state, window placement, media playback, package set or system configuration is changed.
Historical Guia Autonoma architecture choices are treated as intent evidence, not silently promoted to Current implementation.
If implementation work becomes justified, its successor is bounded to observed primitives and current authority rather than a redesign from memory.
